subject: EverGuard BCP assessment - RTO tiers, dependency heatmap and tabletop scheduling
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@everguard.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: EverGuard BCP assessment - initial ask

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our yearly resilience review for EverGuard, we need a compact set of BCP/DR artifacts so our risk committee can sign off. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2025-08-07) if possible?

- RTO/RPO tier matrix (per service and by region) — we want a CSV or spreadsheet that maps service -> RTO tier (minutes/hours) and expected loss window (RPO).
- A dependency heatmap: which external services, caches, and databases are critical for failover decisions.
- Evidence of warm cache / KV-cache priming for hot-path endpoints (sample traces or test logs).
- A brief write-up of your planned tabletop: proposed date(s), attendees, and what we should be prepared to witness.

We may need a short witness period where an Ops engineer demonstrates a recovery step. Please flag any constraints (PII redaction, non-disclosure needs) and include any links to internal evidence or a short ZIP of artifacts if you can.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Senior Manager, Risk & Resilience
EverGuard

Maria — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of what I can share by 2025-08-07 and the follow-up tabletop schedule proposal: 

Deliverables (to be delivered as a zip and Drive folder):
- rto_matrix.csv — per-service RTO/RPO tiers with recovery steps (will include us-east-1 and eu-west-1 rows).
- dependency-heatmap.png and a short markdown explaining service dependencies.
- warm-cache-sample-traces.txt (anonymized traces showing prefix cache priming for our inference runtime).
- runbook excerpt: redwood-runbook-sectionA.pdf (redacted for customer PII).

Tabletop proposal:
- Proposed window: 2025-08-12 or 2025-08-13, 10:00–12:00 PT (we can run a 90 minute witness followed by Q&A).
- Redwood attendees: Marcus Lin (Ops lead), myself (Platform PM), Laura Bennett (EM, Resilience).
- EverGuard attendees suggested: 2–3 risk team reps + one technical observer.

Notes/constraints:
- The warm-cache traces will be redacted to remove customer identifiers; if you need full logs under NDA we can put those in a protected Drive link and route through contracts.
- We'll send the artifacts as a single tabletop-evidence.zip and a Drive folder link 24 hours before the session.

I'll attach a provisional invite and the RTO matrix draft in this thread by EOD.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
